articles.title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
articles.snippet: The U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has reversed course following the FCA's decision to lift its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October.

articles.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
articles.snippet: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.

articles.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
articles.snippet: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

articles.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

articles.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
articles.snippet: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.
